package_info.why_malicious: The package contains a critical vulnerability (CVE-2017-9805) that allows remote code execution (RCE) via unsafe deserialization of XML payloads in the XStreamHandler class. This enables attackers to execute arbitrary code on systems using the vulnerable component, representing a severe security risk.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (when REST plugin is enabled and processes XML payloads)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: createXStream method in XStreamHandler class does not properly handle XML payloads, leading to unsafe deserialization.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Improper deserialization of attacker-supplied XML data, allowing arbitrary code execution.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Deserializing untrusted XML data without proper validation or sandboxing is a well-known vector for remote code execution attacks.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal behavior would require strict validation and safe deserialization of user input. The actual behavior allows arbitrary objects to be instantiated and methods to be invoked based on attacker-controlled XML.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Deserialization is legitimate when used with trusted data sources and proper input validation.
key_indicators: Lack of input validation or sandboxing
Direct use of user-supplied data in object creation

attack_chain.action: Attacker sends a malicious XML payload to an endpoint using the Struts2 REST plugin.
attack_chain.leads_to: XML payload is processed by the vulnerable XStreamHandler.

attack_chain.action: Vulnerable createXStream method deserializes the attacker-supplied XML without validation.
attack_chain.leads_to: Arbitrary code execution on the server (RCE).

behavioral_signatures: Deserialization of XML payloads in REST endpoints
Invocation of XStreamHandler.createXStream on user-supplied data
Unexpected process execution or file writes during XML processing
file_indicators: Presence of XStreamHandler class in deployed application
network_indicators: Inbound HTTP requests with crafted XML payloads targeting REST endpoints
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for use of vulnerable versions of struts2-rest-plugin (2.5.12) in application dependencies. Inspect application logs for deserialization errors or unexpected exceptions in XStreamHandler. Use network IDS/IPS to detect suspicious XML payloads targeting REST endpoints. Employ runtime application security monitoring to detect unexpected process execution or file system changes during XML deserialization.
